claims: The Chicago Cubs opened the 2026 MLB season with a 10-4 loss to the Washington Nationals on March 26, 2026.
The game was at Wrigley Field.
Nico Hoerner received a contract extension.
Matthew Boyd was the starting pitcher.
The Chicago Cubs fell behind early in cold, windy conditions.
The weather was roughly 49°F, windy, with rain showers.
